messages:
elaine: Heads-up: saved view weirdness — I saved from Route /messages pinning model `rw-7b`, it's visible on the route but not on the Model page. Anyone seen this? :confused:
tom: I think listings only check route_refs atm. If saved view referenced model it should show up on model pages too.
harpreet: backend note: we migrated savedviews to per-scope rows and didn't finish populating model_refs index. Easy to miss.
yuri: UX question: do we want automatic cross-context discovery (if model_ref present) or strict scope-only visibility? They imply different mental models.
samira: my vote: auto-discover if user had model pinned at save time, but make ownership & billing explicit. Users get confused otherwise.
harpreet: implementation sketch: add scopes: array and charge_target field. Maintain GSIs on model_refs and route_refs and a tiny visibility_bitset for O(1) checks. Avoid duplicating quota entries.
tom: and server-side ACL guard — don't surface unless viewer has access to origin or to referenced entity. Can't risk exposing partner models.
yuri: UI: show a pill "origin: route /messages" and "charge: route /messages" when surfaced on model page. Also let users edit charge target in the save modal.
samira: quotas: enforce only at creation against charge_target. Surfacing shouldn't allocate extra bucket. Add helpful error when save would exceed quota.
harpreet: telemetry: add savedview.create (scopes, charge_target, origin), savedview.surface (surface_context, resolved_charge, source_index), savedview.missing_index. Dashboards: surface_rate, cross_context_clicks, quota_block_rate.
tom: rollout plan: feature flag `cross_context_savedviews`; start internal, then 10% external. During index build, surface a small toast "Indexing in progress: some views may be missing".
yuri: action items: 1) Tom: API contract for scopes+charge_target. 2) Harpreet: prototype GSIs + visibility bitset. 3) Samira: telemetry + dashboard. 4) Yuri: save modal mocks + microcopy.
tom: opened PR 4999 for API draft.
harpreet: will spike index changes and cost estimate.
samira: will add telemetry events and create dashboard stubs.
deploy-bot: flag `cross_context_savedviews` enabled for 10% canary at 2025-03-05T16:00:00Z :rocket:
elaine: thanks everyone — let's regroup after first canary signals. :calendar:
